subject: IA C interface stub + traffic-shaping review for on-prem VPC deployment
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, EdgeOps Integrations <integrations@edgeops.io>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: IA C interface stub + traffic-shaping review for on-prem VPC deployment

Team / EdgeOps,

Opening thread for the on-prem VPC rollout with Acme Health. Attached is an initial Terraform module stub that models the network interface contracts we discussed on the call — focused on:

- dedicated management subnet (private),
- data plane subnet with explicit egress CIDR ranges,
- an egress gateway pair (HA) for telemetry and model updates, and
- traffic-shaping policy anchors to limit bursty refreshes from agent fleets.

What I need from each of you this week:
- Marissa: confirm the operational acceptance criteria (SRE runbook hooks, expected failover timing).
- Kimberly: quick security checklist run (KMS, certificate rotation cadence, and audit log retention).
- Vivek: CI gating proposal — how this module should be tested in our integration pipeline before we allow merge to main.

EdgeOps: pls review the interface names and egress NAT approach in iac-interface-proposal.tf (attached). Jenna: looping you in to validate the egress CIDRs vs Acme's allowlist; we want to avoid iterative firewall change windows.

Attachments:
- iac-interface-proposal.tf (Terraform module stub)
- ansible-playbook-egress.yml (playbook to configure egress gateway)
- traffic-shaping-diagram.png (hand-drawn diagram from call)

Short timeline: ship module proto by Mon 11/10 so we can run CI simulation on Tue.

Thanks,
Dylan

-- 
Dylan Brooks
Technical Program Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmehealth.com>, EdgeOps Integrations <integrations@edgeops.io>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2025 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IA C interface stub + traffic-shaping review for on-prem VPC deployment

Thanks Dylan — quick read done. High level notes:

1) Acceptance criteria: add an explicit SLA tag in terraform (module variable) and an automated post-deploy check that validates connectivity to our health endpoint within 30s of gateway failover. Put the runbook link in the module outputs.

2) Observability: ensure the ansible playbook drops a Prometheus scrape config on the egress gateway and tags metrics with customer_id=acme.

3) Rollback: prefer a reversible automation step in CI before terraform apply — a staged apply where we first create and test the gateway in staging namespace (feature branch) and only then promote. Document the manual rollback steps in the runbook.

I'll add these as inline comments on the TF file.

-Marissa

-- 
Marissa Cole
Principal Infrastructure PM
Redwood Inference

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, EdgeOps Integrations <integrations@edgeops.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: IA C interface stub + traffic-shaping review for on-prem VPC deployment

Quick confirmation from Acme security side:

- Egress CIDRs in the TF stub look good, but Acme requires source IPs to be single NAT pair per region (not a pool). Can EdgeOps confirm that the ansible playbook will configure deterministic SNAT with a failover IP?
- Audit logs retention: Acme's baseline is 13 months for connection metadata; can you make log-forwarding an opt-out variable in the module?

Also: can we add a smaller token-refresh cadence for the staging gateway so we can exercise short-lived credentials during testing? We can provide test credentials.

Jenna

-- 
Jenna Park
Security Architect
Acme Health

From: EdgeOps Integrations <integrations@edgeops.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IA C interface stub + traffic-shaping review for on-prem VPC deployment

Hi all — EdgeOps here. Quick answers:

- Deterministic SNAT: yes, our gateway image supports a primary/secondary NAT IP configuration. The provided ansible-playbook-egress.yml includes handlers to program the floating IP and ensures conntrack cleanup during failover.
- Log forwarding: we added a variable "audit_forwarding_enabled" with default true; we can surface a module var to flip this per environment. We'll also include a Fluent Bit config snippet in the repo.
- Token-refresh cadence: we can parameterize the staging profile for shorter refresh intervals; recommend 5m for staging to surface issues without spamming prod telemetry.

We've pushed a branch edgeops/iac-acme-review with minor updates and an initial CI job that runs terraform plan + ansible-lint in a container. Link in comment: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NETOPS-94

Attachment: traffic-shaping-diagram.png (updated with explicit shaping anchor points)

Regards,
EdgeOps Integrations

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, EdgeOps Integrations <integrations@edgeops.io>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IA C interface stub + traffic-shaping review for on-prem VPC deployment

Thanks everyone — quick status and next steps:

- Kimberly: can you run the quick security checklist against the branch (edgeops/iac-acme-review) and confirm compliance items (KMS, cert rotation, audit-forward flag). If anything is out, call out a breaking item and we will triage.
- Vivek: please add the CI gating job (terraform plan + ansible-lint + a lightweight network sim) to our merge gate for this repo. Aim: block merge if plan introduces public IPs or new wide egress ranges. Suggested name: net-iac-gate-acme.
- Marissa: I'll draft a short runbook snippet and drop it in the repo under docs/runbooks/acme-egress.md.

EdgeOps: once Kimberly signs off, please create a small PR that flips audit_forwarding_enabled=false for the Acme staging namespace so Jenna can validate retention and forwarding behavior without touching prod.

Target: signoff by Friday 2025-11-14 so we can schedule the maintenance window the following week.

Attaching latest artifacts (stubs + diagram).

Thanks,
Dylan

-- 
Dylan Brooks
Technical Program Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
